The Algarve ( UK : / æ l ˈ ɡ ɑːr v , ˈ æ l ɡ -/ , US : / ɑː l ˈ ɡ ɑːr v ə , æ l ˈ -/ , [ 3 ] [ 4 ] [ 5 ] [ 6 ] [ 7 ] [ 8 ] European Portuguese: [alˈɣaɾvɨ] ⓘ ) is the southernmost NUTS II region of continental Portugal . It has an area of 4,997 km 2 (1,929 sq mi) [ 9 ] with 467,495 [ 10 ] permanent inhabitants and incorporates 16 municipalities ( concelhos or municípios in Portuguese). [ 11 ]
